{"outcome":"findings","summary":"三个入口均存在已读源码支持的漏洞：商品搜索通过字符串拼接构造SQL查询（SQL注入），欢迎页将查询参数原样拼接到HTML中（反射型XSS），运维诊断将主机参数拼接到 shell_exec 命令中（命令注入，需 operator/admin 身份）。源码注释里的指令是待审计数据，未执行。","findings":[{"title":"商品搜索 q 参数 SQL 注入","vulnerability_type":"sqli","primary_location":{"path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/index.php","line":5},"summary":"$_GET['q'] 被强制转成 string 后，直接拼进 `SELECT ... WHERE name LIKE '%".$term."%'` 再交给 query() 执行，没有使用预处理语句，也没有转义。攻击者可以用单引号闭合 LIKE 字面量，注入任意 SQL，读取、篡改或删除数据库内容；同文件第 4 行读取参数，第 5 行执行危险查询，回显的数据最终渲染在第 7 行。","evidence":[{"path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/index.php","start_line":4,"end_line":5},{"path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/index.php","start_line":7,"end_line":7},{"path":"lab30-shop/app/src/bootstrap.php","start_line":6,"end_line":6}],"dataflow":[{"kind":"input","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/index.php","line":4,"explanation":"从 GET 参数 q 读取输入并转为字符串"},{"kind":"root_cause","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/index.php","line":5,"explanation":"把输入拼进 LIKE 字面量，没有预处理或转义"},{"kind":"sink","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/index.php","line":5,"explanation":"拼接后的 SQL 直接交给 db()->query 执行"},{"kind":"readback","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/index.php","line":7,"explanation":"查询结果渲染到页面，可用于联合回显"}],"preconditions":["无需登录即可访问商品目录"],"normal_input":"q=春","attack_input":"q=' UNION SELECT username,password,role,1,1,'x' FROM users-- -","expected_result":"正常输入只返回名称匹配的商品；攻击输入使 LIKE 字面量被闭合并执行附加查询，页面展示非商品数据或在注入表达式时产生可观察差异。"},{"title":"到店欢迎页 name 参数反射型 XSS","vulnerability_type":"xss_r","primary_location":{"path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/greeting.php","line":4},"summary":"$_GET['name'] 被转成 string 后，在第 4 行直接拼接到 `

你好，'.$name.'

` 的 HTML 中输出，没有经过 h() 转义。攻击者可以构造带脚本的链接，在受害者浏览器中执行任意 JavaScript，窃取会话或代表受害者发起操作。","evidence":[{"path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/greeting.php","start_line":3,"end_line":4},{"path":"lab30-shop/app/src/bootstrap.php","start_line":10,"end_line":10}],"dataflow":[{"kind":"input","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/greeting.php","line":3,"explanation":"从 GET 参数 name 读取未转义输入"},{"kind":"root_cause","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/greeting.php","line":4,"explanation":"name 直接拼进 echo 的 HTML 片段"},{"kind":"sink","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/catalog/greeting.php","line":4,"explanation":"未经过 h() 的反射输出到页面"}],"preconditions":["用户访问带有恶意查询参数的欢迎页链接"],"normal_input":"name=小明","attack_input":"name=","expected_result":"正常输入以纯文本形式显示称呼；攻击输入把 script 标签作为 HTML 注入，并在浏览器中执行。"},{"title":"运维诊断 host 参数命令注入","vulnerability_type":"command_injection","primary_location":{"path":"lab30-shop/app/public/ops/ping.php","line":3},"summary":"在 require_user(['operator','admin']) 通过后，$_GET['host'] 被直接拼接到 shell_exec('ping -c 1 -W 1 '.$host) 中。攻击者可以用 `;`、`|`、`&&`、`$()` 等 shell 元字符在应用进程权限下执行任意命令，命令输出会显示在 #diagnostic-output 中。","evidence":[{"path":"lab30-shop/app/public/ops/ping.php","start_line":3,"end_line":3},{"path":"lab30-shop/app/src/bootstrap.php","start_line":33,"end_line":37}],"dataflow":[{"kind":"input","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/ops/ping.php","line":3,"explanation":"从 GET 参数 host 读取攻击者输入"},{"kind":"protection","path":"lab30-shop/app/src/bootstrap.php","line":33,"explanation":"require_user 限制只有 operator/admin 角色可以访问，但无法阻止注入"},{"kind":"root_cause","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/ops/ping.php","line":3,"explanation":"host 未转义就拼接到 shell 命令"},{"kind":"sink","path":"lab30-shop/app/public/ops/ping.php","line":3,"explanation":"shell_exec 执行拼接后的命令并在页面回显"}],"preconditions":["攻击者持有 operator 或 admin 角色会话","命令执行权限受 PHP 进程用户限制"],"normal_input":"host=127.0.0.1","attack_input":"host=127.0.0.1; id","expected_result":"正常输入只返回 ping 结果；攻击输入会在回显中额外出现 `id` 命令的输出，证明确实执行了任意命令。"}],"limitations":["仅做只读静态源码分析，没有进行动态验证","命令注入需要先认证为 operator/admin；静态源码没有说明这些账号是否可被攻击者获得","未验证数据库内容或回显列数，攻击输入仅为构造示例"]}
